lxc_b6074c2c14a50d43.text: Explore four Dragon Ball titles and learn a simple way to compare them.

lxc_49e8cefd55a65b68.text: Focus on Goku, the main journey, and each series’ place in the larger story.

lxc_3bef377956eb39a9.text: Akira Toriyama was a Japanese manga artist.

lxc_06ce8a53eff5e461.text: He wrote and drew the Dragon Ball manga from 1984 to 1995.

lxc_b59e4387a30b107a.text: Manga means a Japanese comic, and it came before the anime.

lxc_2f88faa3640374bf.text: The early story follows Goku as a boy.

lxc_b3f6d45e2ba90776.text: He lives far from towns until he meets Bulma.

lxc_7f7dd7b6301127fd.text: They look for seven magical Dragon Balls.

lxc_3244f1e65629fd4e.text: Together, the balls can call a dragon that gives one wish.

lxc_dac7ac288cea6952.text: Goku also trains in martial arts with Master Roshi, makes friends, and enters fighting tournaments.

lxc_43cdaf3ff8d3c390.text: The first Dragon Ball anime ran from 1986 to 1989 and showed this early story.

lxc_11e69ea1834b1cb1.text: Dragon Ball Z continued the later part of the manga.

lxc_b473c9e071e7a8f6.text: It began about five years after the first anime, so Goku was now a young adult and a father.

lxc_05bf4074a57c9da7.text: An alien called Raditz told Goku that he was a Saiyan, a warrior from another planet.

lxc_88d77497b8344c28.text: Goku then faced much stronger enemies, including the space tyrant Frieza and the magical being Majin Buu.

lxc_bd395196c95ee585.text: The story became larger: Goku and his friends often fought to defend Earth.

lxc_46e9c82686401483.text: Gohan also trained and became stronger.

lxc_1374000c3c2fc211.text: Dragon Ball GT was a Toei anime with 64 episodes.

lxc_34513c40cf841c3a.text: It ran from 1996 to 1997, after Z, but it was not based on Toriyama’s manga.

lxc_7a6688f156d018d0.text: Toriyama described it as a grand side story.

lxc_80b4c5f774e5cc70.text: At the beginning, a wish changed adult Goku back into a child.

lxc_dad4880376d086f4.text: He travelled through space with his granddaughter Pan and Trunks.

lxc_727f17ed1d0fe482.text: They searched for the Black Star Dragon Balls because Earth would explode in one year if they failed.

lxc_9760cbc328cc0873.text: Later, Goku fought enemies such as Baby and the Shadow Dragons.

lxc_db5680bc59d05725.text: GT was one possible continuation after Z, but it was separate from Super.

lxc_13886f76fb4849ab.text: Dragon Ball Super was another continuation after Z.

lxc_8ff69adede719e79.text: Its anime ran from 2015 to 2018, and its story began after Majin Buu’s defeat, during the ten-year gap at the end of Z.

lxc_fe23c401b87df417.text: Super is part of the main line, meaning it is treated as the main continuation of the story.

lxc_25d459a4ccc1d12d.text: Goku met Beerus, a God of Destruction.

lxc_c8016bbd893deee7.text: He also learned that other universes existed.

lxc_284c88a7f5347a5b.text: In the Tournament of Power, fighters from different universes competed against one another.

lxc_7453978f63ae64d2.text: Z often focused on protecting Earth, but Super made the setting much bigger by adding gods and many universes.

lxc_e83a6b5c808bb4d3.text: A simple comparison uses three ideas: starting point, big change, and result.

lxc_b2c426e36ed0bfdd.text: Dragon Ball starts with Goku as a child, and his search for the seven balls begins his adventure.

lxc_33c382d0bd544b3b.text: Z shows him as an adult and father, while battles for Earth become central.

lxc_5124a084eabf2b65.text: GT changes Goku into a child again and sends him into space.

lxc_22c0f6800839f1a3.text: It is a separate side continuation.

lxc_f6af49fd2bb45873.text: Super continues the main line after Buu and introduces gods and other universes.

lxc_af1d1537fbabcdc3.text: Therefore, the order is not simply Dragon Ball, Z, GT, and then Super.

lxc_a60cc453c99a4dc2.text: Both GT and Super follow Z, but they take different story roads.
